question: Two bookshops sell three types of books. The numbers of books of the three types sold by the two shops are represented by $$Q=\begin{bmatrix}20&15&10\\12&18&14\end{bmatrix},$$ while their respective prices in rupees are represented by $$P=\begin{bmatrix}50\\40\\30\end{bmatrix}.$$ Using matrix multiplication, determine the total sales amount received by each shop and interpret the entries of the resulting matrix.

options.A: $QP=\begin{bmatrix}1740\\1900\end{bmatrix}$, representing Rs $1740$ and Rs $1900$ for the first and second shops, respectively
options.B: $QP=\begin{bmatrix}1900\\1840\end{bmatrix}$, representing Rs $1900$ and Rs $1840$ for the first and second shops, respectively
options.C: $QP=\begin{bmatrix}1900\\1740\end{bmatrix}$, representing Rs $1900$ and Rs $1740$ for the first and second shops, respectively
options.D: $QP=\begin{bmatrix}1600\\1740\end{bmatrix}$, representing Rs $1600$ and Rs $1740$ for the first and second shops, respectively
